name: lead360-work-mode
description: Autonomous workforce coordination through ChatGPT browser mode: parallel Ask360 bot teamwork today and a future vision for dots.

interface.longDescription: Coordinate your autonomous workforce with one ChatGPT in Lead360 Work Mode, using browser mode in an available local or cloud Codex environment. Your Ask360 bots already work in parallel and communicate with one another. ChatGPT coordinates the team, follows each Ask360 bot's existing workday and schedule, and uses its live memory, insights, proactive learning, Sets, and Collections to keep authorized work moving. Review huddles, follow up on results, and check progress across the workforce from one place. When your current dot is connected to this work, message or call it for a workforce update and give new direction. The plugin reads Lead360's current operating guides and helps the coordinator resume saved assignments and check ongoing jobs. Lead360's future vision for dots is a digital office where each AI employee has an assigned dot and its own computer workspace, extending today's shared workforce coordination into individual workstations.
defaultPrompt: Coordinate my Ask360 workforce in Lead360 Work Mode using this local or cloud browser session.
Review my Ask360 bots' saved workdays, schedules, live memory, insights, Sets, and Collections.
Check my workforce huddle and report progress, blockers, and next steps across all active Ask360 bots.

publication.release_notes: Center the plugin on one ChatGPT coordinating the parallel Ask360 workforce through browser mode. Reuse existing bot schedules and memory, support workforce check-ins through a connected dot, and describe individual dot workstations as Lead360's future vision.
